note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

precepts.why:
The book of Sirach was written by Jesus the son of Sirach, a wise man, around 200 to 175 BC. That is the Greek time period, and the book was written to help fight against Greek influence in the time it was written. So when Sirach speaks of “They that sit upon the mountain of Samaria”, the question is who, during the time of the Greeks, sat upon the mountain of Samaria. Second Maccabees answers it.

“Not long after this the king sent an old man of Athens to compel the Jews to depart from the laws of their fathers, and not to live after the laws of God”. That is the Greek king commanding Judah to depart from the laws of our God and serve the Greek laws and the Greek fashions instead. This is called assimilation, integration, Hellenization: we became Greeks, Greek citizens, like African Americans today. Same thing.

“And to pollute also the temple in Jerusalem, and to call it the temple of Jupiter Olympius”. The Greeks polluted the temple in Jerusalem, in Judah, and called it the temple of Zeus, for Jupiter is Zeus. “And that in Garizim, of Jupiter the Defender of strangers, as they did desire that dwelt in the place.” Garizim is a mount in Samaria. The Greeks built and sat upon Mount Garizim.

So who sat upon the mount in Samaria at this time? The Greeks. Other translations of Sirach 50:26 call them Edomites, verbatim: Edomites that sat upon Samaria. Then Sirach is telling you the Greeks were Edomites.

The rest of the verse follows: “they that dwell among the Philistines” are the Hamites, and “that foolish people that dwell in Sichem” is the northern kingdom, the silly nation that loved the heathen, the not a people of Deuteronomy 32. It is always them trying to take our land. This is war.

The heirs are Israelites.

note.label: Navigating Through Paul's Letters: Walking Through Galatians

precepts.why:
“There is neither Jew nor Greek”. Christians read it like a soft effeminate man, neither Jew nor Greek, brother, and say it means anybody. The people of Christianity have no idea about history. Why does Paul reference Greeks?

“Not long after this the king sent an old man of Athens to compel the Jews to depart from the laws of their fathers, and not to live after the laws of God”. Your law, your culture and your race go hand in hand with God. The Bible says love your neighbour as yourself; that is law. Deny your race and you deny your laws; deny your law and you deny your God.

“Neither was it lawful for a man to keep sabbath days or ancient fasts, or to profess himself at all to be a Jew.” It was basically illegal under the order of the king to call yourself a Jew or keep Jewish customs. So over time we became Greeks, Gentiles.

That is who Paul is writing to. The ye that were kept under the law in verse 23 are the same ye called Jews and Greeks, bond and free, male and female. Do not escape that context. Whatever your title or status in that present world, Jew or Greek, free like Paul or bond like others, “ye are all one in Christ Jesus”: all God's chosen people.

precepts.why:
The Greeks did it too. Under Antiochus, 1 Maccabees 1:60-61: “they put to death certain women, that had caused their children to be circumcised.” “And they hanged the infants about their necks, and rifled their houses, and slew them that had circumcised them.” After they killed the mothers, they hung the circumcised babies from their dead mothers' necks and put them on display for the people to see. They lynched our babies on their mothers' necks. It is the same persecution recorded of the mothers who circumcised their children and were led about the city with the babes at their breasts.

Esau was so demonic and wicked that he ran around checking who was circumcised, running through our houses and killing anyone who circumcised a child. Who does that? Demons.

That is Deuteronomy 28:66: “thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life”. Keeping the law of God, circumcising your child as the covenant commands, could cost a mother her life and her baby's. It is the same spirit that hanged our princes, burned our mothers and crushed our babies here in America. Same game, different characters: judgment is like a ring, recurring over and over.

Peter and the apostles answered, “We ought to obey God rather than men”, and the mothers of the Maccabees did so to the death. Christ was hanged on a tree too; the King and his children have all hung under the same curse, until the Lord says enough.

“And in the day of the king’s birth every month they were brought by bitter constraint to eat of the sacrifices;” They forced us to celebrate birthdays, the king's birth. When you read about birthdays in the Bible some calamity always happened: Herod's birthday, and John was beheaded; Pharaoh's birthday. It was always some death, so honouring your day was always against God's law. So now here you are today, mostly you women: it's my son's birthday, can we celebrate the birthday? They forced us to celebrate the king's birthday. We are not supposed to be celebrating nobody's birthdays; get it through your heads.
